subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should ambient room_event runs use a session-stable prompt/tool contract, including the safe non-owner owner-only Gateway tool inventory for every sender, while keeping effective visible delivery message-tool-only?
rationale: The source-level cache fix is clear, but owner-sent room-event tool inventory and the split between prompt-facing and effective delivery are product and security-boundary policy choices rather than purely mechanical cleanup.

options.title: Stabilize Prompt, Keep Strict Delivery
options.body: Keep room-event visible output message-tool-only by default, but make all cache-sensitive prompt and binding facts follow the stable session/group visible-reply contract.

options.title: Add Room-Event Reply Configuration
options.body: Introduce an explicit room-event visible-reply setting with docs, migration/upgrade review, and tests for automatic versus message-tool delivery.

options.title: Document Strict Behavior Only
options.body: Treat strict room-event delivery as intended and document the cache/prompt tradeoff for operators instead of changing runtime behavior.

recommendation.title: Stabilize Prompt, Keep Strict Delivery
recommendation.body: Keep room-event visible output message-tool-only by default, but make all cache-sensitive prompt and binding facts follow the stable session/group visible-reply contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is closest to the visible-reply and ambient-room product contract introduced by the group visible-replies work.
